purpose: Show engineers, designers and marketers what working at Alliance AI Partners is like (the four values in practice, how we work inside partner teams, how you learn), be honest that the team and roles are placeholders and samples, and get them onto the talent list.

seo.title: Careers | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: Build AI tools and software inside partner teams in the US, Australia and the UK, with an AI company based in the Philippines. See how we work, the sample roles and how hiring works, then join the talent list.

content.heading: Build it, run it, and see it grow.
content.lead: Alliance AI Partners is an AI company based in the Philippines. You work inside our partners’ teams in the US, Australia and the UK, and you stay with what you build after launch.

content.heading: What we ask of each other.
content.lead: The four values behind every partner project, and what each one means on a normal day.

items.title: One team, one goal
items.text: You work as part of a partner’s team, and their goals become yours. We judge our work by their results, like more sales or hours saved. When something goes wrong, we say “we,” and we fix it.

items.title: Simple on purpose
items.text: You pick the simplest thing that does the job. Every automation gets an owner and a backup plan, and you write down how it works, clearly enough for a new hire to follow.

items.title: Trust holds everything up
items.text: You protect partner data as if it were our own. If AI isn’t the right answer, you say so, even when it means less work for us. Bad news goes out early, with a plan to fix it.

items.title: Clear the path
items.text: We go first. We use what we sell, and a new tool reaches partners only after it has proven itself in our own work.

sections.name: How we work
sections.job: Show how the work runs inside a partner's team: the four steps and the commitments every role keeps.
sections.desktop: Navy chapter. Heading/1 head (title set on two lines). Two columns: the four steps as hairline rows (Heading/4 name 180 | Body text) at 628, and the commitments as a Ribbon Cyan check list at Body/LG.
sections.mobile: Head stacked; the four steps as rows (name over text), then the check list.

content.heading: Inside the partner’s team.
content.lead: You work in their tools and toward their numbers, with all of Alliance AI Partners behind you.

items.title: Understand
items.text: We learn how the partner’s business works and where it gets stuck.

items.title: Plan
items.text: We pick the right fix. Sometimes it doesn’t involve AI at all.

items.title: Build
items.text: Our engineers and designers build it, on our own or inside the partner’s team.

items.title: Run and grow
items.text: We keep it working, improve it over time, and help the partner find new customers.

body: A person reviews every piece of work before it reaches a partner.
Work happens in the partner’s systems wherever possible.
If an off-the-shelf tool or a simpler fix costs the partner less, we say so.

sections.name: Learning
sections.job: Show how people learn here: new tools first, written notes, a review on everything.

content.heading: Learn on real projects.
content.lead: New tools reach you first, every system is written down, and a person reviews everything you make before a partner sees it.

items.title: New tools reach you first
items.text: Every new AI tool we consider runs on our own business before it goes near a partner. You are one of the people trying it, and only the tools that prove themselves stay.

items.title: Everything is written down
items.text: How every system works is written down, clearly enough for a new hire to follow. You learn a project from its notes, not from guesswork.

items.title: A second pair of eyes
items.text: A person reviews every piece of work before it reaches a partner, so everything you make comes back with feedback.

content.heading: How hiring works.
content.lead: Four steps from your application to an offer.

items.title: Apply
items.text: Send your links and a few lines about something you built. No cover letter needed.

items.title: First call
items.text: A [30-minute] call about your work and ours. Bring your questions too.

items.title: Work sample
items.text: A short task like the real work, reviewed by the people you would work with.

items.title: Offer
items.text: We decide within [one week] of the work sample and tell you either way.

body: Sample process. Each job post confirms its own steps and times.

notes: Header marks About as current (Careers sits with the company pages). Every promise comes from the Brand DNA: the four values and their bullets, the four steps, the review and weekly-progress commitments, the honest-pricing line about cheaper fixes, and the vision of engineers, designers and marketers. Nothing is invented: the team is four Person tiles with [Name] / [Role] and Photo to come; every role is marked 'Sample role'; the hiring process is marked as a sample with [30-minute] and [one week] placeholders (owner check). One Primary in the hero and one in the closing form (y 659 and 6368 on desktop; 457 and 8216 on mobile). The ribbon signature appears once (the Ribbon rule under the hiring steps; vertical on mobile). Images: two new slots, a hero split (IMG-30-1) and an image inside the large bento card (IMG-30-2). Grounds: Daylight hero, Daylight values, navy how-we-work, Daylight learning, team and roles, navy hiring, Daylight talent list, navy footer. Lint clean on both frames; no horizontal overflow on mobile. The Job row has no Mobile variant: on mobile its title and meta are set to fill and wrap beside the link.
